purpose: Synthetic fixture preparation for the Web library and TypeScript sync engine only; no implementation or behavior is established.

dependencyGateDetails.rule: This plan is preparation only. Do not implement or run behavior before dependencies are accepted. Until the card and 03 §11 dependency lists are reconciled, honor their union as a conservative gate.

neverUse: real account, production service, PostgreSQL, S3 or browser session
literal body, URL, title, image, key, token or SQL parameter in evidence
official crypto KAT or cross-platform crypto vector result before T15 acceptance
fixturePolicy.expectedResults: Assert externally visible state, synthetic identity/scope, immutable op and cursor behavior, generation, transaction boundaries and side-effect counts. Do not invent DTOs, error enums/copy, retry codes or unaccepted adapter behavior.
fixturePolicy.statusMeaning: NOT_RUN means no Web UI, sync, storage, browser, integration, database or service behavior has been verified.

interfacePreparation.sourceLabels: Case source fields are pointers for later review, not evidence that every cited requirement has been exhaustively covered.
interfacePreparation.syncBoundary: Treat ciphertext and frozen DTO bytes as opaque; this plan does not test encryption, PostgreSQL/RLS, S3 provider semantics, or desktop/native behavior.
interfacePreparation.budgets: Use injected synthetic counters for capacity boundaries; do not derive actual storage charge from content size.
interfacePreparation.webLifecycle: Web background execution is not guaranteed; plan foreground recovery only.
interfacePreparation.errorMapping: Exact typed API and user-facing mappings remain OPEN_QUESTION while T06/T16/T20 and applicable task contracts are unaccepted.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic visible results and focused field with spaces/caret.
fixtureCases.action: Type and navigate Left/Right/Home/End/Down; press non-composing Enter.
fixtureCases.expected: Editing keys preserve caret/value; Down selects; Enter invokes one action; no preview from edit keys.
fixtureCases.observation: Value/caret, selected synthetic ID, callback count.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic composing search input with selected result behind it.
fixtureCases.action: Press Enter and Esc during composition, then non-composing action.
fixtureCases.expected: Composition commit/cancel does not trigger paste, execute, or panel exit; later action follows normal rule.
fixtureCases.observation: Composition state, query, panel state, callback counts.

fixtureCases.input: Visible synthetic card, no active job.
fixtureCases.action: Single click, double click, hold Enter for repeat.
fixtureCases.expected: Single click only selects; double click creates one job; repeats do not duplicate side effects.
fixtureCases.observation: Synthetic ID, event metadata, job count.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic request A owns generation gA and is held; request B starts as gB with distinct IDs and selection, then A resolves late.
fixtureCases.action: Start A, then B; verify starting B invalidates/cancels A; finish B, then release A. Observe each request/result generation and selected ID.
fixtureCases.expected: Generation ownership stays with the originating request; only gB can update current results/selection. A cancellation signal is observable, but no return enum is assumed.
fixtureCases.observation: Request/result generation tags, abort signal/event, result IDs, selection, and update count after late A.

fixtureCases.input: Two synthetic pages loaded; next page fails once.
fixtureCases.action: Press End, request next page, observe error, retry locally.
fixtureCases.expected: Keep loaded results and selection; End targets loaded tail; local retry does not reset all pages.
fixtureCases.observation: Page IDs, selection, retry action.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic preview open in Web panel; focus also tested in textarea/button.
fixtureCases.action: Press Esc twice across separate events.
fixtureCases.expected: First Esc closes preview only; second closes panel; input controls do not trigger extra global action.
fixtureCases.observation: Preview/panel state and callback counts.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic unlocked cloud body/preview/thumb/search canaries and a separate anonymous item; worker has one staged late result.
fixtureCases.action: Lock cloud; verify worker termination and late-result suppression; then issue a new direct cloud repository/API read for the same canary.
fixtureCases.expected: Cloud body/preview/thumb/search are unavailable; worker terminates; late result is suppressed; a direct post-lock cloud read is rejected or masked without returning canary data. Anonymous session remains within its separate session boundary; exact read-error mapping stays OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: Scopes/IDs, worker termination, visible result IDs, direct-read status/category, and absence of canary values.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic anonymous session at injected 32 MiB cap with committed old IDs and proposed item.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt add, inspect export/loss notice, simulate refresh.
fixtureCases.expected: Reject new item and retain old; expose explicit export choice/loss notice; refresh loses anon session; no sensitive IDB plaintext.
fixtureCases.observation: Injected counters, IDs, visible notice/action, post-refresh presence.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic HTTPS/Web permission denied and a manually-entered textarea fallback.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt user-initiated paste/copy path with permission denied.
fixtureCases.expected: Manual paste remains available; explain capability degradation; no false paste/clipboard success or background capture claim.
fixtureCases.observation: Permission category, visible fallback, success callback count.

fixtureCases.input: Injected local/outbox budget-full state with protected saved item and pending draft.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt a new cloud-scope mutation.
fixtureCases.expected: Show capacity/recovery affordance; retain protected item/draft; do not silently change to local-only.
fixtureCases.observation: Injected budget, item/draft IDs, scope, success count.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic account A has pending outbox, worker, subscription and opaque key handle; B has separate namespace.
fixtureCases.action: Switch A to B; release delayed A callback and attempt dispatch.
fixtureCases.expected: A worker/subscription/handle lifecycle is closed; B cannot see A data; A wire never dispatches under B.
fixtureCases.observation: Synthetic IDs/scopes, teardown and dispatch counts.

fixtureCases.input: Offline unlocked empty DB, no-match query, partial index, a delayed initial query, and a separate fixture yielding two nonzero results.
fixtureCases.action: Observe initial loading; cancel the delayed query; query the no-match, partial, and two-result fixtures.
fixtureCases.expected: Initial loading is not presented as empty/no-results; cancellation ends that request without stale output; empty/no-results/partial/nonzero results remain distinct; cached unlocked data remains usable with no full-cloud claim.
fixtureCases.observation: Loading/cancel state transitions, state category, IDs/count, coverage/claim flags, and generation ownership.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic library at viewport widths >=1024, 768-1023, and <768 logical px.
fixtureCases.action: Navigate sidebar/list/detail and return between list/detail routes.
fixtureCases.expected: Use specified layout transitions, preserve selectable body, visible keyboard focus, no clipped core task.
fixtureCases.observation: Viewport, route, focus, visible synthetic IDs.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic authenticated account with cloud locked, a distinct local-only session, and an unsent cloud draft; session expires while the draft is pending.
fixtureCases.action: Render locked page; expire session; try cloud search/preview and local-only read; renew login without device approval/recovery.
fixtureCases.expected: Show approve-device/recovery path; cloud body/preview/thumb/search remain hidden; login alone does not unlock; the unsent draft is retained across session expiry and awaits authorized recovery/sync; local-only remains distinct.
fixtureCases.observation: Auth/lock/scope states, draft digest/presence, visible IDs, and unlock state before/after login.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic Web clipboard capability allowed/denied variants under HTTPS and user gesture.
fixtureCases.action: Use Paste/Upload/Copy actions; exercise denied permission fallback.
fixtureCases.expected: Use only user-initiated actions; denial offers manual textarea; copy failure gives optional selectable text; no background-capture claim.
fixtureCases.observation: Gesture/permission category, visible fallback, callback counts.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic current device metadata and second authorized device; downloaded-content flag.
fixtureCases.action: Inspect current device/authorization/last-sync/recovery controls; request synthetic revoke.
fixtureCases.expected: Controls show fixture metadata and revoke/recovery/export/delete choices; do not claim already downloaded plaintext is erased. Exact provider/DTO outcome remains OQ.
fixtureCases.observation: Visible control categories, synthetic device IDs, no plaintext values.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic unlocked cloud cache and app-managed browser stores; cookie-present flag.
fixtureCases.action: Refresh, inspect app-managed durable stores, try cloud read before unlock.
fixtureCases.expected: No persistent cloud unlock capability in app-managed stores under test; cookie alone does not expose cloud data; worker starts only after approved unlock.
fixtureCases.observation: Store classes, lock/worker state, visible IDs.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic ordered operations at configured batch item/byte boundaries and per-op committed/rejected results.
fixtureCases.action: Submit fixture batch and consume response.
fixtureCases.expected: Each result maps to corresponding op in request order; partial success is per-op, confirmed successes are not regenerated; do not assert unfrozen UI error copy.
fixtureCases.observation: op IDs/order/status classes, receipt/update counts.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic opId=op-01 with canonical hash h1; first commit response is lost; exact same opId/hash retry plus same opId with changed hash h2.
fixtureCases.action: Retry identical immutable bytes; then submit the changed-hash variant under op-01.
fixtureCases.expected: Exact retry returns the original receipt/committedSeq with one version; changed hash returns frozen HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, stops that op, and never silently creates a replacement opId.
fixtureCases.observation: opId/hash digests, exact status/code, version count, receipt and committedSeq.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic ordered change log exceeding 50 items or 128 KiB, with fixed upperSeq.
fixtureCases.action: Fetch pages using same upperSeq, inject response-byte cap boundary.
fixtureCases.expected: toSeq advances only through returned rows; no skipped changes; hasMore/next page uses fixed upperSeq.
fixtureCases.observation: Seqs, page sizes, upperSeq, applied IDs.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic pull page and prior local cursor; crash barriers before/after local transaction commit.
fixtureCases.action: Apply page, inject crash cases, then replay same page.
fixtureCases.expected: Rows and applied cursor commit together; replay is idempotent; cursor never advances from HTTP receipt alone.
fixtureCases.observation: Cursor/IDs before-after, commit result, duplicate count.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic requests sent with known watermarks; response seq100 arrives before older seq99; separate new-current-state probe below sent watermark.
fixtureCases.action: Deliver responses out of order and then run current probe.
fixtureCases.expected: Maximum seen watermark never decreases; valid old in-flight/old-H response below latest arrival watermark is tolerated; new current probe below its sent watermark is isolated as rollback.
fixtureCases.observation: Request-sent watermark, response order, retained max, isolation event.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic snapshotId=snap-90, epoch='1', fixed high-water H='90'; local priorSeenHighWater='120'; concurrent change log contains seq 91..120.
fixtureCases.action: Download all pages at the same snapshotId/epoch/H; apply catchup through seq 120; validate, then attempt namespace swap and bootstrap ACK.
fixtureCases.expected: Every page retains H='90'; do not publish/swap or bootstrap-ACK before catchup reaches at least priorSeenHighWater='120'; then namespace/cursor swap is atomic and ACK follows it.
fixtureCases.observation: snapshotId/epoch/H, catchup seqs through 120, prior watermark, swap and ACK event order.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic current library, unsent draft, old READY outbox op with immutable wire_bytes, and partial recovery namespace; snapshot expires or epoch changes mid-page.
fixtureCases.action: Cancel/interupt page flow; start a new snapshot fixture; reconcile old outbox receipt/state before any dispatch.
fixtureCases.expected: Do not publish partial recovery namespace or overwrite old library/draft; cancellation/expiry preserves old outbox bytes and does not blindly replay the old op; use the gated recovery/reconciliation path without assuming error text.
fixtureCases.observation: Old/new namespace IDs, draft digest, outbox opId/wire_bytes/state, receipt probe, cursor and publish/dispatch event order.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic D1 stale baseRevision='7' and local draft; remote D2 currentRevision='8', currentHeadVersionId='ver-remote-8', currentSeq='120'.
fixtureCases.action: Submit stale update and consume conflict response; render retained draft/head comparison.
fixtureCases.expected: Frozen terminal HTTP 409 REVISION_CONFLICT includes currentRevision='8', currentHeadVersionId='ver-remote-8', currentSeq='120'; retain local draft and remote head, never overwrite by device time; create conflict copy only after explicit action with a new identity.
fixtureCases.observation: Exact status/code/three response fields, revisions, draft/head IDs, choices and mutation count.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic mutation references an attachment that is not ready and a matching upload dependency.
fixtureCases.action: Stage outbox; observe state before attachment readiness; then mark fixture attachment ready.
fixtureCases.expected: Before readiness the only allowed outbox state is WAIT_DEPENDENCY; do not use BLOCKED, fabricate a ready reference, or dispatch early. Exact UI mapping remains OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: Outbox state transition, attachment state, dispatch count and user-visible category.

fixtureCases.input: Injected pending/additional counters near 209715200-byte hard limit; old committed draft/op protected.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt crossing cloud mutation and inspect cleanup/export choices.
fixtureCases.expected: Block new cloud mutation, retain old queue/draft; allow safe read/delete/export path as contract permits; no implicit local-only conversion.
fixtureCases.observation: Counters, IDs, scope, recovery affordances.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic READY persisted cloud outbox and page lifecycle transitions.
fixtureCases.action: Close/suspend page, reopen/foreground, and inspect resume opportunity.
fixtureCases.expected: Persisted outbox can resume in foreground; UI never promises continuous Web background execution; anonymous session loss remains disclosed.
fixtureCases.observation: Op state, foreground event, dispatch opportunity, notice.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic shared DTO fixture with opaque ciphertext bytes/manifest and fixed Rust/Web serializer inputs; no key or crypto vectors.
fixtureCases.action: Pass fixture through the planned TS boundary and compare canonical protocol bytes/state with the reference fixture.
fixtureCases.expected: Preserve frozen wire bytes, Decimal, and identity fields; this does not assert encryption correctness or official cross-platform crypto vectors, which remain gated by T15.
fixtureCases.observation: Canonical byte digest and DTO fields only; no secrets.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic canonical Decimal strings above 2^53, PG signed-bigint max='9223372036854775807', overflow='9223372036854775808', and a mixed per-op receipt batch.
fixtureCases.action: Persist/recover/serialize the Decimal strings; submit a boundary operation at max and an overflow operation; consume per-op results.
fixtureCases.expected: Preserve canonical Decimal strings exactly without JSON-number conversion; max signed bigint='9223372036854775807' round-trips; overflow='9223372036854775808' is rejected with frozen COUNTER_EXHAUSTED and never wraps to zero; update only individually receipted ops.
fixtureCases.observation: Exact Decimal strings, rejection status/code, no-wrap result, op IDs and status classes.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic browser reports private mode or cache quota that makes persistent Web cache unavailable; online service fixture remains reachable.
fixtureCases.action: Load the library with persistence unavailable; observe notice and perform a synthetic online read.
fixtureCases.expected: Show a visible notice that browser cache may not persist; allow the eligible online use to continue; make no promise that cached data survives refresh.
fixtureCases.observation: Visible notice category, online request/result state, and absence of a cross-refresh durability claim.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic initial query held behind a cancellation barrier plus a later query fixture returning two distinct results.
fixtureCases.action: Observe initial loading; cancel the held query; start the second query and release its two-result response.
fixtureCases.expected: Show loading before completion; cancellation does not masquerade as zero results or publish stale results; the completed second query shows exactly two nonzero results (count=2) with its own generation and selection.
fixtureCases.observation: Loading/cancel transitions, generation IDs, result count=2, result IDs and selected ID.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic persisted outbox op with state=SENDING, opId=op-crash-01, immutable wire_bytes fixture and matching digest.
fixtureCases.action: Inject process-crash boundary after SENDING persistence and recover the local outbox.
fixtureCases.expected: Recovered state is READY and wire_bytes are byte-for-byte unchanged; do not regenerate the op or ciphertext.
fixtureCases.observation: Before/after state, opId, wire_bytes exact byte comparison and digest.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic SENDING op with receipt receipt-01, confirmedRevision Decimal='8' and committedSeq Decimal='120' returned by the server fixture.
fixtureCases.action: Inject local transaction barriers while persisting receipt/revision/seq and clearing the acknowledged outbox row.
fixtureCases.expected: In one local transaction, persist the receipt, confirmedRevision and committedSeq and clear the acknowledged outbox row atomically; pre-commit failure leaves the prior outbox recoverable; no state can clear the op without all three confirmed fields.
fixtureCases.observation: Transaction commit marker, receipt/revision/seq, outbox row/state and crash recovery view.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic persisted draft/view/outbox and pendingBytes counter; inject a transaction failure before commit while staging one mutation.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt the mutation with a failure barrier before commit; inspect all four persisted components and success indication.
fixtureCases.expected: Rollback is all-or-nothing across draft, materialized view, outbox and pendingBytes counter; pre-commit failure preserves their prior values and reports no success; successful publication is possible only after commit.
fixtureCases.observation: Before/after digests and counter, outbox count, commit result and visible success state.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic JSON push request exceeds configured syncBatchBytes by one UTF-8 byte and contains two otherwise valid operations.
fixtureCases.action: Submit the oversized request and inspect the response plus all affected synthetic server records.
fixtureCases.expected: Return HTTP 413 with limitKey=syncBatchBytes and zero operation/version/change/receipt writes; response code follows the frozen 413 family, with UI wording left OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: HTTP status, limitKey, operation/version/change/receipt counts before and after, and visible error category.

openQuestions.reason: T21 task card lists T14/T17/T19/T20, while 03 §11 lists T20/T15/T16/T18/T19. Keep the union gated until the accepted task graph is reconciled.
T06/T16 DTO and database behavior are not accepted; exact error discriminators, return mapping, retry classification and UI copy are not asserted.
T15 crypto KAT/cross-platform vectors and T16 canonical wire serialization are not accepted; opaque fixture pass-through is planning only, no crypto vector is claimed.

T01/T06 script/harness readiness, real browser HTTPS/clipboard permissions, accessibility thresholds and exact error presentation remain unverified.
T07/T20 accounting and Web cache charge/eviction remain unresolved; tests use injected counters only.
P11 states UI responsibilities and does not promise erasure of downloaded plaintext; exact revoke API/result mapping and copy await accepted contracts.
